_about: Cook's scene data (R4, decision 24), in the design's own units (1600x900, D15). views[<view>].safe = [x0, y0, x1, y1]: what the child must reach in that Cook view (every tappable thing and shelf chip, measured with build/measure_cook_views.mjs at level 4, plus a margin). js/cook/frame-hookup.js hands it to the shared stage (js/shared/stage.js), so on a tablet that view grows up to data/layout.json stage.itemScale, cropping only what lies outside. A view not listed keeps the whole box (stage.scenes.cook). data/layout.json's stage.scenes["cook:<view>"] wins over this file.

views._about: Measured 1 Oct (R4) at level 4 over every Station-lab station: the x-range of every tappable thing and shelf chip, plus 20 px; the pantry also keeps its tally on the fridge (mechanics.fetch.tally, x 1406). Only x is constrained (null: the height is free). The hob view (tadka, stir) and the stations' shelf bands that reach the edges keep the whole box until they are laid out for 4:3.
